messages:
Sasha Kim: Hey — planning a short customer case for next week's launch. Deliverables: 15s social clip, 45s product highlight, 1-page case PDF, and a short webinar mention. Need quote + signed consent.
Theo Marshall: I can grab the validated infra numbers and a screenshot. Will upload P95/P99 + cost delta by EOD.
Priya Das: I'll write the one-pager and social copy. Prefer to keep the social line non-technical; put exact percent reductions in the PDF.
Cass Rivera: Customer asks to preview the pull quote 24h before publish and to approve any logo usage. Also wants a single-sentence case highlight for webinar slide.
LegalBot: Consent template (use verbatim): "I consent to Redwood Inference using my quote, company name, and logo in marketing materials for this launch. I confirm these materials are not designated as confidential in writing. I also approve use of my company trademarks as specified." Capture signer name/title/date.
Sasha Kim: Draft social pull: \"Redwood made our inference predictable and cut our costs — finally ship with confidence.\" Open to edits.
Theo Marshall: Suggest a stat in the 1-pager only: cost per 1M tokens ~39% lower; P95 improved ~35ms. Will add method note.
Priya Das: Alternate social short: "Lower cost, steady latency, faster releases." Which reads better for X platform?
Cass Rivera: Customer prefers the Sasha version. Will confirm they are OK with the 39% stat in the PDF only.
LegalBot: Add a consent checkbox on the hosted form: \"I authorize Redwood Inference to use my quote and logo as described (link to consent).\" Signed PDF must be emailed to legal@redwood.ai with signer name/title/timestamp.
Sasha Kim: Recording plan: remote-record Wed 11am PT — 8–10 min session: 3 questions + short b-roll. Cass will coordinate.
ClipBot: Recommend capturing an extra 12s of b-roll and a separate 10s candid intro for social cuts. Set capture format to 1080p/48kbps audio.
Cass Rivera: Customer tentatively Wed 11am. I'll confirm and book a recording link. Also will request the exact person/name/title for the consent PDF.
OpsBot: Routing: demo leads -> SFDC ENT-789; dedicated interest -> AE-DED-44; press -> comms. Added hidden form field deployment_interest with options hosted/dedicated/private. Webhook (test): https://hooks.redwood.ai/lead/ent-789.
Sasha Kim: Add UTM params utm_campaign=sparkcase_launch&utm_source=social. Also add a hidden param for source_channel=marketing.
Theo Marshall: Uploaded numbers to /files/benchmarks/sparkcase: screenshot + short methodology note (sample window 2 weeks, production traffic subset).
Priya Das: I'll draft copy by Tue noon, include two social variants and the one-pager. Cass will send final quote to the customer Tue afternoon.
Cass Rivera: Customer asked for final quote preview 24h before publish and will sign consent Wed morning. I'll drop the signed PDF here when received.
LegalBot: Once signed, send to legal@redwood.ai. Include signer name/title/date/time in the email body. We'll timestamp it on receipt.
Sasha Kim: Launch workflow: when consent PDF is in, OpsBot/ClipBot/LaunchBot to kick asset builds. Target publish Thu 2pm PT. Everyone react with :white_check_mark: when your item is done.
ClipBot: Noted. I'll queue editing tasks after raw footage upload and export 15s and 45s cuts.
OpsBot: Webhook and routing tested in staging. Will re-test on publish.
Sasha Kim: Thanks team — we want a quick, low-friction asset set. Keep the social short and emotional; leave the hard metrics in the one-pager. Closing loop: please ping when consent is uploaded.
